name: Serial Studio
blurb: Serial Studio lets you visualize real-time data from microcontrollers and connected devices.
description:
Serial Studio lets you visualize real-time data from microcontrollers and connected devices. It's ideal for monitoring sensor output, debugging hardware, and analyzing telemetry from sources like serial ports, Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE), and TCP/UDP.

Whether you're a student, hobbyist, or engineer, Serial Studio gives you insight into what your hardware is doing, live.

• Cross-platform: Native support for Windows, macOS, and Linux

• CSV export: Save incoming data for offline analysis

• Multiple inputs: Serial, BLE, TCP/UDP (MQTT available in Pro version)

• Custom dashboards: Design interfaces with visual widgets using the Project Editor

• Advanced decoding: Use JavaScript to parse structured or binary data streams

Note: This Flatpak package includes the open-source GPLv3 version of Serial Studio only. Commercial features such as MQTT integration, 3D plotting, CANBus/Modbus and XY plots are not included.

install.label: Flatpak
install.note: Works on every distribution, sandboxed and kept up to date for you.
